# langsmith_agent (Resource)

Manages a workspace-scoped LangSmith agent and its automatically created LOCAL, DEVELOPMENT, STAGING, and PRODUCTION environments. Environments are owned by the agent, not separate Terraform resources. Import with `<agent_id>` or `<workspace_id>/<agent_id>`. Requires a LangSmith deployment that supports the Agent Platform API.

**Warning:** Destroying or replacing an agent also deletes its environments, tracing projects, and attached runtimes. Use Terraform `prevent_destroy` to protect production agents. The API may report successful deletion even if downstream runtime or project cleanup fails.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_agent" "support" {
  agent_id    = "support-agent"
  name        = "Support Agent"
  source_type = "EXTERNAL"
  agent_type  = "CUSTOM"

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "langsmith_agent" "development" {
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  agent_id     = "development-agent"
  source_type  = "EXTERNAL"
}

output "production_project_id" {
  value = langsmith_agent.support.environments["PRODUCTION"].tracer_session_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Immutable workspace-unique agent identifier. Changing this destroys and recreates the agent and its environments.
- `source_type` (String) Agent source: LSD, MDA, EXTERNAL, or FLEET. Changes require replacement because the API restricts source transitions.

### Optional

- `agent_type` (String) Agent type: CUSTOM or CODING. Defaults to CUSTOM; updates in place.
- `name` (String) Display name. Defaults to agent_id on creation; updates in place.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace (tenant) ID. Defaults to the provider workspace. Changing this replaces the agent.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `environments` (Attributes Map) Environments keyed by LOCAL, DEVELOPMENT, STAGING, or PRODUCTION. Use tracer_session_id to reference each environment's tracing project in other resources. Refreshed from the API, including externally deleted environments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `id` (String) Agent identifier (same as agent_id).

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Agent environment UUID.
- `tracer_session_id` (String) Tracing project UUID.
- `tracer_session_name` (String) Tracing project name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langsmith_agent.support support-agent
terraform import langsmith_agent.development 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/development-agent
```
